CustomObject.label: OI Health Severity Descriptor
CustomObject.description: The severity/score-band registry for Org Health, extending the OI_Node_Type_Descriptor__mdt registry pattern (GraphUI.md §20-21) onto a score-band axis instead of a type-key axis. Resolved once per session, looked up one layer above presentational components (oiHealthSeverityBadge, oiHealthScoreRing never resolve severity themselves), mandatory generic fallback for a score outside every configured band. ADR-0026.
